name: "Scrub Life" Camping Style Nurse Mug (15 oz)
seoTitle: Scrub Life Nurse Mug with Gift Box
metaDescription: A 15 oz Scrub Life ceramic mug in a camping style that arrives gift boxed. A cute gift for nurse practitioners, dental assistants, and doctors.
summary: A 15 oz camping style ceramic mug that reads Scrub Life, sent in a gift box. A cute pick for anyone who wears scrubs to work, from NPs to dental assistants.
whyItWorks: Scrubs are the great equalizer in healthcare. Nurses, nurse practitioners, dental assistants, and doctors all spend their workdays in them, which is what makes a Scrub Life mug so easy to give. It works across job titles, so it is a smart choice for a mixed office gift exchange or a thank you to a whole clinic team.

The camping mug style gives it a relaxed, outdoorsy look that feels different from the usual nurse mug. At 15 oz, it holds a generous pour for the first coffee before a shift, and the title notes it is microwave and dishwasher safe, which matters to people who reheat their coffee more than once a day. It arrives in a gift box, so it is ready to hand over at a birthday, a holiday party, or a work anniversary. Add a bag of locally roasted coffee or a pack of fun pens for a little bonus.
goodToKnow: Microwave and dishwasher safe according to the title, which is handy for daily use.
Arrives in a gift box, so no wrapping needed.
Check the listing photos for the color options available.

faq.q: Is this mug only for nurses?
faq.a: No. Scrub Life fits anyone who wears scrubs, including nurse practitioners, dental assistants, and doctors.

faq.q: Can it go in the microwave?
faq.a: The title says it is microwave and dishwasher safe, so reheating coffee should not be a problem.
